notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1; step 1 was correct.
Each LED is on its own pair of top-half columns: cathode in column 2n-1, anode in column 2n (row a). LED n is driven from Mega pin n+1 (LED 1 on pin 2, up to LED 12 on pin 13).

The 220 ohm resistor sits on the anode side. Leg 1 is in the anode column (row e) and leg 2 is across the centre gap in the same column (row f). The signal wire is in that bottom-half column (row j) and goes to the Mega pin.
Each LED cathode column is joined by a short black wire to the top negative rail (tn). One black wire joins the Mega GND to the same rail. The Mega port 'GND.1' is assumed to be a ground pin.
The exact breadboard hole positions are my own tidy layout. The circuit image only shows which LED, resistor and pin go together.
